description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) for AI-powered tools, specifically for translation verification and code review, using the 'commander' library for command parsing, and integrates with external modules for translation verification and AI code review. It also executes git diff commands and handles file I/O.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Class from 'commander' library used to define CLI commands and options.

methods.name: program.parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and executes the appropriate command.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that initiates command parsing.
